learnings.title: Federal Reserve Board press feed: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve Board press releases RSS (federalreserve.gov/feeds/press_all.xml, read 2026-11-26) lists the item 'Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026' (category Monetary Policy; pubDate Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:00:00 GMT per the research agent). Only the feed headline was confirmed; the minutes body was not read.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: finance plan may review the minutes later; no operational action.

learnings.title: GitHub changelog: More predictable notifications on GitHub.com
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-24-more-predictable-notifications-on-github-com (feed pubDate Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:40:59 +0000; read 2026-11-26) states that starting December 1, 2026 GitHub is migrating notifications on GitHub.com over the course of a week to make subscriptions more predictable, correct unexpected behavior and support growing activity scale. Only the feed excerpt was read.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: system plan may check whether any cerniva notification-dependent workflow is affected after 2026-12-08; no code change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-12-10 whether any cerniva workflow saw notification behavior change.
